name: mirage
text: Thanks, that changes it. The code keeps each key's balance separately, so I can't see a bug that would copy one key's numbers onto the others. The Odds API's own replies show the same 64 used and 436 left for all 23 keys. I can't test the keys from here, so I can't tell yet whether that's real or a recording fault. A quick check: in Settings > APIs > The Odds API, tap Test on two keys. If the two numbers differ, it's a recording fault and I'll fix it. If they match, The Odds API is reporting a shared quota, and 23 keys give you 500 credits, not 23 times that.
